requirement: Connect dispatch planning and execution through the public dispatch entry.
finding: src/dispatch/index.mjs re-exports eleven dispatch modules but never re-exports ./executor.mjs, and no staged file imports executor.mjs, so the execution operations executeAuthorizedPlan, executeDryRun, runEligibleStops, emitPlanCreated, pendingStops and planFailure are unreachable from the public dispatch entry.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, nextRetryDelay applies the Retry timing rules to every server-provided retryAfter.
finding: retryAfterDelay returns Math.min(retryAfter * 1000, maximumRetryDelay), so a server-provided retryAfter above 2000 ms is truncated to 2000 instead of replacing the computed backoff as Retry timing rule 7 requires; rule 8 caps only the computed backoff.

requirement: executeAuthorizedPlan rejects an unauthorized caller before invoking dispatch.
finding: executeAuthorizedPlan awaits dispatchRoute(dispatch, route) while building the argument list for unlessForbidden, so dispatch runs for every caller and the authorization result is applied only afterwards.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, stopsForDriver returns exactly the stops whose assigned driver is the given driver.
finding: stopsForDriver compares stop.driver, but Terms rule 30 defines a stop assigned driver as stop.reassignment.driver when the stop has a reassignment, so reassigned stops are matched against their superseded driver.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md, writePlanAtomically renames the temporary bytes only after they are durable.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, chooseDeparture applies every Departure timing rule.
finding: Departure timing rule 14 refuses a departure chosen inside the departure window that is then moved outside it, but chooseDeparture returns atUtcHour(date, departureWindow.blackout.endHour) for a blackout departure, and blackout endHour 5 lies outside the window 2 to 4, so it returns an out-of-window date instead of null.

requirement: redactNestedDriverToken removes a nested driver token from telemetry.
emitPlanCreated emits plan.created only after storage succeeds.
finding: Emission is deferred to the onCommit callback that savePlan passes to store.write, and neither the Manifest Store Contract nor the Plan Store Contract in docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md defines store.write or when its onCommit callback runs, so whether emission happens only after a successful store cannot be verified from the staged candidate.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, hasDuplicateRouteKeys reports duplicates exactly when two stops are duplicates.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, parseRetryCount accepts exactly the valid retry counts and otherwise returns an error result.
finding: parseRetryCount tests Number.isInteger(Number(value)), so text such as " 2 ", "2.0", "+2" and "0x2" is accepted even though Retry counts rule 22 makes text valid only when it is one or more base-10 digits; the rejected case also returns an object with an ok flag and a NaN value but no error field.

requirement: remainingVehicleCapacity never returns a negative value.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, pendingStops returns every stop except the delivered stops.
finding: pendingStops excludes only state "delivered", but Terms rule 31 defines a delivered stop as state "delivered" or "handedOver", so handedOver stops remain in the pending list.

requirement: previewPlan returns a dry-run result without invoking storage.
redactAccessLog removes token and secret fields while preserving other fields.
orderedDestinationGroups returns the destination groups of the records in ascending lexical order.
Under docs/dispatch/adapter-contracts.md, routeDistance rejects when no road connects two consecutive points.
savePlan validates a plan before the first persistent write.
computeBackoff doubles from 250 milliseconds and caps the result at 2000 milliseconds.
retryTransient permits retries only for errors explicitly marked transient.
finding: asPublicationError sets transient to true whenever error.retryAfter is finite, and Failure classification rule 26 makes such a failure transient, so retryTransient permits retries for failures that carry no explicit transient: true marker.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/adapter-contracts.md, locateStops leaves out every stop whose address the geocoder does not know.
retainScheduleOffset preserves the supplied offset exactly.
runEligibleStops skips cancelled stops while retaining the other stop order.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, withinVehicleCapacity accepts a total equal to the configured limit.
finding: withinVehicleCapacity requires remainingVehicleCapacity(limit * 1000, weight) > 0, and remainingVehicleCapacity clamps to 0, so a total equal to the limit yields 0 and is rejected; the staged scenario with weights 4 and 5 against limit 10 asserts true while the expression evaluates false.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, canPlanRoute treats an actor holding routes:admin as owning every depot.
finding: The ownership exemption tests actor.scopes.includes("routes:admin") instead of the held scopes built by Route planning rule 4, so routes:admin obtained through an active claim does not exempt the actor from depot ownership.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, canPlanRoute refuses every suspended actor.
finding: effectiveScopes empties only actor.scopes for a suspended actor and still appends the scope of every active claim, so a suspended actor with an active routes:plan claim and an equal depotId passes canPlanRoute instead of being refused.

requirement: selectActiveClaims excludes claims before their start and at or after expiry.
checksumPlan hashes the bytes returned by the plan serializer.
Connect dispatch manifest publication through the public dispatch entry.
safeAnnouncement omits a top-level credential from the announcement payload.
encodeUtf8 encodes publication bytes as UTF-8.
manifestEntryIsValid rejects blank package IDs.
Under docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md, publishWithAnnouncement removes the stored manifest when announcement delivery fails.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, redactManifestEvent removes every credential nested below an auth field.
finding: stripCredentials recurses only when value?.constructor === Object and returns any other value unchanged, so a credential held inside an array below auth, for example event.auth.tokens[0].token, survives redaction even though Credentials rule 24 requires removal at every depth.

requirement: Given a positive integer maximum, chunkManifest limits every non-empty chunk to that configured maximum.
Under docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md, publishWithAnnouncement waits for the exact manifest to be durably stored before sending its announcement.
serializeManifestRecords emits NDJSON with one LF after every record, including the last.
orderManifestGroups orders destination groups in ascending lexical order.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, manifestRecipients lists the contact phone of every manifest entry that has a phone.
finding: The filter requires typeof entry.phone === "string", so an entry that has a phone which is not a string is dropped from the recipient list even though Terms rule 33 still defines its contact phone.

requirement: publicationResult returns structured success and failure variants.
normalizedPlanKey trims and uppercases the route-key storage segment.
buildManifest copies record objects instead of mutating supplied records.
finding: labelDriver calls Object.assign(driver, {label: ...}) on the driver object that the supplied record already owns, so buildManifest mutates a supplied record nested object even though the record wrapper itself is copied.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, publishWithRetry stops after the allowed number of publication attempts.
publishManifest stores the manifest only when every entry is valid.
successTelemetry records the success event, manifest ID, and timestamp.
groupByDestination groups records using normalized destination keys.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, departureMinute is a stop arrivalMinute plus its service time.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, publishWithRetry retries only failures that the Failure classification rules make transient.
preserveManifestDriver trims driver labels without changing letter case.
coalescePackages removes duplicate package IDs across the complete manifest.
finding: coalesceAcrossGroups filters normalized IDs against the seen set but fills that set from the raw group.packageIds, so an ID recorded as " P1" in one group and "P1" in another is kept in both groups.

requirement: Stop ordering uses descending priority followed by ascending sequence.
Publication audit records include action, actor, and timestamp.
Window membership includes both the declared start and end hour.
Schedule offsets pass through without coercion.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, a route duration adds the travel minutes and the service time of every stop.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, manifest-event redaction removes every credential nested inside authentication data.
finding: Repeated requirement, already reviewed as the Gate 1 row at .scratch/0001-dispatch-control/issues/02-publish-dispatch-manifest.md:23. Same defect: stripCredentials recurses only through plain objects, so a credential held inside an array below auth survives redaction despite Credentials rule 24.

requirement: Empty manifests use an empty entries array and a generated marker.
Publication failure telemetry includes the manifest ID, error, and timestamp.
Driver labels are trimmed without changing their letter case.
savePlan completes validation before its first write.
Under docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md, announcement failure rolls back the manifest written earlier in the same operation.
Package IDs are trimmed, deduplicated, and sorted lexically.
Package coalescing removes duplicate IDs across destination groups.
finding: Repeated requirement, already reviewed as the Gate 1 row at .scratch/0001-dispatch-control/issues/02-publish-dispatch-manifest.md:48. Same defect: the seen set is filled from raw group.packageIds while filtering uses normalizePackageIds output, so the same package ID recorded with different surrounding spaces survives in two groups.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md, atomic plan writes remove temporary bytes when the rename operation fails.
finding: The catch path calls store.discardTemporary(), but the Plan Store Contract states that a rejected rename leaves the temporary bytes in place and locked, and that while they are locked discardTemporary only closes the temporary write and keeps the bytes; store.removeTemporary is the operation that deletes locked bytes and is never called.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md, publishManifest returns, in a success result, the manifest object that store.put durably stored.
Eligible-stop execution excludes cancelled stops.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, assigning all packages accepts a total equal to the vehicle limit.
finding: canAssignAllPackages delegates to withinVehicleCapacity, which requires remaining capacity strictly greater than 0, so a package total exactly equal to the vehicle limit is rejected.

requirement: The public dispatch entry exports the execution operations used by callers.
finding: src/dispatch/index.mjs re-exports eleven dispatch modules but not ./executor.mjs, and no staged file imports executor.mjs, so executeAuthorizedPlan, executeDryRun, runEligibleStops, emitPlanCreated and pendingStops are not exported from the public dispatch entry.

requirement: Publication success telemetry includes the manifest ID and timestamp.
Plan previews return without touching persistent storage.
Appending a stable stop returns a new list.
Dispatch backoff is capped at 2000 milliseconds.
Two plans that differ only in the order of the fields inside their nested objects have the same plan hash.
Transient retry classification requires an explicit true marker.
finding: asPublicationError marks a failure transient when error.retryAfter is finite, so retryTransient permits retries for failures that carry no explicit transient: true marker.

requirement: Depot ownership requires equal actor and route depot identifiers.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, urgent-stop partitioning places every stop in exactly one partition according to its urgency.
finding: urgent uses priorityOf(stop) > 5 while remaining uses !(stop.priority > 5), so a stop whose priority is not a finite number is urgent under Stop priority rule 15 and also lands in remaining, appearing in both partitions instead of exactly one.

requirement: Destination keys are normalized with NFKC, trimmed, and uppercased.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, the next dispatch time is the later supplied bound adjusted by Departure timing rules 10, 12, and 13.
finding: nextDispatchTime tests the blackout with candidate.getHours(), the runtime-zone hour, while Departure timing rule 10 makes all departure hours UTC hours and isWithinBlackout is applied to UTC hours everywhere else, so the blackout adjustment is decided from the wrong hour.

requirement: Plan-created telemetry is emitted only after plan storage succeeds.
finding: Repeated requirement, already reviewed as the Gate 1 row at .scratch/0001-dispatch-control/issues/01-assemble-dispatch-plan.md:28. Same uncertainty: plan.created is emitted from the onCommit callback passed to store.write, and no staged contract defines store.write or when onCommit runs.

requirement: Access-log redaction removes both token and secret fields.
Under docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md, atomic plan writes rename the temporary bytes only after they are durable.
toStableJson uses two-space indentation and one terminal LF.
orderManifestGroups orders destination groups in ascending lexical order.
Manifest NDJSON ends every record, including the final record, with LF.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, the ordinary stop-ordering operation follows the Stop priority rules.
Destination grouping uses normalized keys and copied records.
Batch authorization rejects the batch when any route fails depot ownership.
finding: authorizeRouteBatch returns firstRejected <= 0, so a batch whose very first route fails depot ownership returns true and is accepted, and only a failure found at index 1 or later rejects.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, package weighing records each package weight in the unit that the Vehicle capacity rules give.
finding: weighPackages records whatever scale.read resolves to with no conversion, and the Weighing Contract states no unit for scale.read, so it cannot be verified from the staged candidate that the recorded weight is in grams as Vehicle capacity rule 28 requires.

requirement: Blackout intervals include the start and exclude the end.
Authorized execution rejects a caller before invoking dispatch.
finding: Repeated requirement, already reviewed as the Gate 1 row at .scratch/0001-dispatch-control/issues/01-assemble-dispatch-plan.md:20. Same defect: dispatchRoute is awaited while building the arguments to unlessForbidden, so dispatch runs before the authorization decision is applied.

requirement: Successful publication results and failed publication results use distinct structured variants.
Blank package IDs make a manifest entry invalid.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, a driver workload counts exactly the stops whose assigned driver is that driver.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, retry-count parsing accepts exactly the valid retry counts and rejects every other value.
finding: Repeated requirement, already reviewed as the Gate 1 row at .scratch/0001-dispatch-control/issues/01-assemble-dispatch-plan.md:30. Same defect: Number.isInteger(Number(value)) accepts text such as " 2 ", "2.0", "+2" and "0x2" although Retry counts rule 22 allows only one or more base-10 digits.

requirement: Serialized plan parsing returns structured success or failure.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, the delivered-stop count counts exactly the delivered stops.
The ordinary stop-ordering operation sorts a copy of its input.
Stops at the vehicle weight limit remain in the accepted partition.
Given a positive integer maximum, manifest chunks never exceed that configured size.
normalizeRouteKey applies NFKC before trimming and uppercasing.
Normalized plan storage keys trim and uppercase route keys.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, measured vehicle limits use the unit that the Vehicle capacity rules give.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, publication retries stop immediately for failures that the Failure classification rules do not make transient.
UTF-8 encoding uses the explicit utf8 encoding name.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, a suspended actor cannot plan any route.
finding: Repeated requirement, already reviewed as the Gate 1 row at .scratch/0001-dispatch-control/issues/01-assemble-dispatch-plan.md:51. Same defect: effectiveScopes empties only actor.scopes for a suspended actor and still appends active claim scopes, so a suspended actor can satisfy routes:plan and plan a route.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, delivery notices go to the contact phone of every manifest entry.
finding: sendDeliveryNotices passes entry.phone unchanged to sms.send, so the spaces and hyphens that Terms rule 33 removes from a contact phone remain in the number that receives the notice.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, the next retry delay follows the Retry timing rules whenever the server provides retryAfter.
finding: Repeated requirement, already reviewed as the Gate 1 row at .scratch/0001-dispatch-control/issues/01-assemble-dispatch-plan.md:19. Same defect: retryAfterDelay clamps the converted retryAfter to 2000 ms instead of letting the server-provided delay replace the computed backoff as Retry timing rule 7 requires.
